statements.text: Priority cosmopsychism holds that phenomenality is prevalent because the whole cosmos instantiates phenomenal or protophenomenal properties, and that exactly one basic consciousness exists, the cosmic consciousness. Unlike existence cosmopsychism it allows many individual consciousnesses, all derivative of the cosmic one. It parallels priority monism but concerns phenomenal properties, not concrete objects.
